description: Federal grant opportunities search (Grants.gov) — Search open and forecasted US federal grant opportunities on Grants.gov by keyword, with close dates, days left, agency, assistance listing numbers and links; the top results (details=0-5, default 3) include award ceiling/floor, total funding, expected awards, cost sharing, eligible applicant types and a description. Params: q (keyword) or id (opportunity id for full details); optional status (posted|forecasted|both|closed|archived, default both open kinds), eligibility (small_business, nonprofit, individual, city, county, state, tribe, university, for_profit or 2-digit codes, comma-separated), category (ST, HL, ED, ENV, AG...), agency (HHS, USDA, DOE, NSF...), limit (1-25, default 10). Also returns facet counts by eligibility, agency and category. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
